extracted.name: Chocolate chip Banana bread
extracted.description: Inspired by wanting to use up over ripe bananas.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350° F combine flour, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl set aside.
Beat brown sugar and butter in a separate bowl until smooth
Stir in eggs, vanilla, and mashed bananas until well blended
Stir banana mixture into flour mixture until just combined DONT OVERMIX!
Pour batter into a loaf pan
Bake in the oven for 60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted the middle comes out clean. Let cool for 10 minutes
